inputs.name: server
inputs.description: The FreeIPA server, as a map of one name to an address, or to a host object with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file, jump_hosts, os, hostname or ip.

inputs.name: clients
inputs.description: Hosts to enrol as FreeIPA clients, by name, in the same form as server. A name can't be both the server and a client.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.description: DNS domain of the FreeIPA deployment, such as ipa.example.com. Hosts are named <name>.<domain> unless a host object sets hostname.

inputs.name: realm
inputs.description: Kerberos realm. When null, the domain in upper case.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password of FreeIPA's admin user, set when the server is installed. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: ds_password
inputs.description: Password of the LDAP Directory Manager, set when the server is installed. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_ds_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: enroll_principal
inputs.description: User clients enrol as, with enroll_password. Clients listed in client_otps use their one-time password instead.

inputs.name: enroll_password
inputs.description: Password of enroll_principal. When null, admin_password. Pass it at run time; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: client_otps
inputs.description: One-time enrolment passwords, by client name, from ipa host-add --random or --password. A client listed here joins with its own instead of enroll_principal.

inputs.name: setup_dns
inputs.description: Run FreeIPA's integrated DNS server, BIND, on the server, with a zone for domain.

inputs.name: dns_forwarders
inputs.description: Upstream DNS servers the integrated DNS forwards to, with setup_dns. When empty, the ones in the server's /etc/resolv.conf.

inputs.name: manage_hosts_file
inputs.description: Set each host's name to its fully qualified name and map the names of the host and the server to their addresses in /etc/hosts. FreeIPA needs both to resolve. Turn it off when your DNS already does that.

inputs.name: mkhomedir
inputs.description: Create a home directory when a FreeIPA user first logs in to a client.

inputs.name: server_options
inputs.description: Extra arguments to ipa-server-install, such as ["--no-ntp"] or ["--setup-kra"]. Don't put passwords here: they would land in state.

inputs.name: client_options
inputs.description: Extra arguments to ipa-client-install, such as ["--no-ntp"]. Don't put passwords here: they would land in state.
